{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Identify and remove QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
qa_mask = df['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99
print(f"Number of QA orders: {qa_mask.sum()}")

# Remove them from the dataset
df_clean = df[~qa_mask].copy()

# Filter for completed orders from loyal customers
df_loyal_completed = df_clean[
    (df_clean['customer_segment'] == 'loyal') & 
    (df_clean['status'] == 'completed')
]

# Compute mean revenue
total_revenue = df_loyal_completed['revenue_clean'].sum()
num_orders = len(df_loyal_completed)
mean_revenue = total_revenue / num_orders

print(f"Number of loyal completed orders: {num_orders}")
print(f"Total revenue: {total_revenue:.2f}")
print(f"Mean revenue: {mean_revenue:.2f}")"}
